name: Volunteering with a Guardian (ages 13 to 17)
what_you_do: Help care for injured and orphaned wildlife at a rescue center, usually one 4-hour shift a week. A parent or guardian volunteers with you.
who_can_apply: Volunteers are 18 or older. Teens ages 13 to 17 may volunteer alongside a guardian (an adult over 25 approved by the guardian is also allowed, per the FAQ). Email for the minor rules.
duration: Weekly 4-hour shift for most roles (not rescue and transport roles)
deadline_text: No dates posted. A mandatory orientation is required.
how_to_apply: Use Apply to Volunteer on the page (online form). For minors, email volunteer@sbwcn.org or call (805) 681-1080.
notes: Teens cannot volunteer alone. The page lists no youth-only program. Confirm first with the volunteer team how it works for a teen and guardian.
